awards.name: FIRST Global Challenge Award
awards.description: Awarded to teams that earn the most match points.

awards.name: FIRST Global Grand Challenge Award
awards.description: Awarded to teams that accrue the most cumulative points over the course of the competition.

awards.name: Zhang Heng Award for Engineering Design
awards.description: Awarded to teams whose robot exhibits excellent engineering and displays elegance and effectiveness during the Challenge.

awards.name: Ustad Ahmad Lahori Award for Innovation in Engineering
awards.description: Awarded to teams that demonstrate creativity and innovation in building their robot to complete an aspect of the Challenge.

awards.name: Dr. Mae Jemison Award for International Unity
awards.description: Awarded to teams that emulate the best qualities of FIRST Global by breaking down barriers, demonstrating Gracious Professionalism, and building bridges with fellow teams.

awards.name: Rajaâ Cherkaoui El Moursli Award for Courageous Achievement
awards.description: Awarded to teams that exhibit a “can-do” attitude throughout the Challenge, even under difficult circumstances, or when things do not go as planned.

awards.name: Sofia Kovalevskaya Award for International Journey
awards.description: Awarded to teams that documented and shared their FIRST Global experience with the rest of the FIRST Global community.

awards.name: Albert Einstein Award for FIRST Global International Excellence
awards.description: Awarded to the teams whose robots performed the best during the FIRST Global Challenge and exemplified all of the tenets of the FIRST Global community.

awards.name: Francisco José de Caldas Award for Sustainable Excellence
awards.description: Awarded to an individual who helped contribute to strong and sustainable FIRST Global programs.

awards.name: Al Khwarizmi Award for Outstanding Supporter
awards.description: Awarded to an institution, sponsor, or government that has added a positive dimension to the FIRST Global Challenge.

silver.recipientName: Mr. Faysal Jarmakani and Mr. Omar Jarmakani

bronze.recipientName: the National Institute for Science, Technology, and Innovation
